uq_fp4.note: repo quantize_fp4 (E2M1 + UE8M0/32, ceil scale, no rotation), exactly what uqmt kernel reads

uq_fp4_c156.note: paper scale rule: E=round(log2(0.156*amax)) with clip, no rotation

uq_fp4_whtk.note: repo quantiser + WHT on K only (paper's rotation)

uq_fp4_paper.note: paper recipe: c=0.156 clip scale + WHT on K (Q rotated, q.k invariant) + BF16 first/last 2 layers; Q kept bf16 (paper: FP8); bytes exclude BF16 edge layers

nvfp4.note: E4M3 scale / 16 + fp32 global per write

int4_qserve.note: per-token-head asym int4, fp16 scale+zero; no SmoothAttention

kivi4.note: K per-channel (32-token blocks), V per-token (group 32), fp16 residual 128 tokens, asym fp16 scale/zero; bytes exclude fp16 residual

kivi2.note: K per-channel (32-token blocks), V per-token (group 32), fp16 residual 128 tokens, asym fp16 scale/zero; bytes exclude fp16 residual

kvquant4.note: simplified KVQuant: per-channel K (32-token blocks, post-RoPE, not pre-RoPE), equal-mass non-uniform levels fitted on the block (no offline sensitivity-weighted k-means), 1% fp16 outliers, fp16 residual 128; bytes include ~1% outliers at 4B each

kvquant3.note: simplified KVQuant: per-channel K (32-token blocks, post-RoPE, not pre-RoPE), equal-mass non-uniform levels fitted on the block (no offline sensitivity-weighted k-means), 1% fp16 outliers, fp16 residual 128; bytes include ~1% outliers at 4B each
